title: Rust: reformat imports to one-per-line baseline
description:
Run cargo +nightly fmt across all Rust crates to establish a one-import-per-line baseline.

## Why
rust/rustfmt.toml now has imports_granularity = "Item" which splits grouped imports (use foo::{a, b, c}) into separate lines. This reduces merge conflicts when multiple agents add imports to the same file - each addition lands on its own line instead of contesting a shared brace-group.

## What changes
Every .rs file with grouped imports will be reformatted. Example:
```rust
// Before
use std::{collections::HashMap, sync::Arc, fmt};

// After
use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::fmt;
use std::sync::Arc;
```

## Scope estimate
- ~20 crates in rust/
- Diff will touch most .rs files (noisy but mechanical)
- Zero semantic change - purely formatting

## Steps
1. Verify nightly toolchain: rustup show
2. Install if needed: rustup install nightly
3. Run formatter: cd rust && cargo +nightly fmt
4. Verify build: cargo build --all-targets
5. Verify tests: cargo test
6. Single commit: "style(rust): reformat imports to one-per-line"

## Risks
- None if tests pass - formatting only
- Conflicts with any in-flight Rust branches (coordinate timing)

## When to do
- Before starting parallel agent work on Rust code
- Or: accept gradual migration as files are touched
